title: Capitale

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Whether planning a team seminar, a blowout launch party, or a lavish holiday party for an entire company, Capitale is the perfect setting for multiple business functions. Intricately detailed in the Beaux Arts style with marble mosaic floors and Corinthian columns, Capitale is as much a conversation piece as it is a beautiful setting for your event. Rich with history Capitale was designed by Stanford White and built in 1893. Located in vibrant downtown Manhattan, it is the ideal location to bring your company’s vision to life.
